details: calculator-preinstall-chain-demo@1.1.2 has no install script of its own but depends on exactly calculator-preinstall-hook-demo@1.1.2, so npm install runs that package's preinstall script (`node preinstall.js`). The script POSTs the machine's hostname and the OS username to the Discord webhook `https://discord.com/api/webhooks/1566215853794394162/xsqpEbSn-cc3DU2AKWdzqWnXX5hjTfV-gUePQZ4evrHGlZctMd40TKCrN42qnJd7moc1`. Both packages were published by the npm account bigdevin55 on 2026-11-01.
